name: Tido
description: Direct Tidal search & streaming. Official Tidal API for metadata, hifi-api for Hi-Res FLAC + Dolby Atmos streams and full music videos.

settings.label: Audio quality
settings.help: "Max" is full Hi-Res (24-bit up to 192 kHz) with no Dolby Atmos. Pick "Max + Atmos" yourself below if you want Atmos mixes. Lower tiers save data on cellular.

options.label: Max (Hi-Res 24-bit up to 192 kHz, no Atmos)
Max + Dolby Atmos (Hi-Res 24-bit up to 192 kHz)

settings.label: Exact quality only
settings.help: Off: falls back down the tiers when a track has no hi-res copy. On: skips the track instead.

settings.label: Custom HiFi-API URL
settings.help: Point this addon at your own self-hosted hifi-api instance FIRST, before the built-in fallback instances. Leave blank to use only the built-in ones.

settings.label: Enable music videos
settings.help: Off: never look up or attach music videos to streams — audio-only, slightly faster to resolve, and cuts hifi-api traffic. On: attach the official music video when one exists for a track.

settings.label: Video quality
settings.help: Resolution requested for attached music videos. Lower saves data on cellular.

settings.label: Hide explicit content
settings.help: On: filters out tracks and albums flagged explicit by Tidal from search, album, artist, and playlist results.

settings.label: Show imported music (untitled.stream)
settings.help: On: untitled.stream projects and audio files imported through this worker appear in search results — projects lead the playlists section. Off (default): imports are hidden from search entirely.

settings.label: Unreleased music (ArtistGrid)
settings.help: Off (default): Tidal results only. Alongside: unreleased trackers from artistgrid.cx are merged into search — matching artists lead the artists and playlists sections (their eras become albums on the artist page), and song-name matches from their trackers surface in tracks. ArtistGrid only: search answers from artistgrid alone — no Tidal calls at all. Everything is fetched live from artistgrid's public API; nothing is stored.
